# Hero Images for Login & Register Pages

Place the following hero images in this folder:

## Registration Page
- **register-hero.jpg** - Background image for Create Account page right panel
  - Shows: Students learning, classroom scenes, or happy students
  - Recommended size: 1200x800px or 16:9 aspect ratio
  - Format: JPG or PNG
  - Optimized for web (under 800KB)

## Login Page
- **login-hero.jpg** - Background image for Login page right panel
  - Shows: Online learning, student studying, or educational setting
  - Recommended size: 1200x800px or 16:9 aspect ratio
  - Format: JPG or PNG
  - Optimized for web (under 800KB)

## Fallback Behavior
If images are not found, the pages will display with gradient backgrounds only, maintaining a professional appearance.

## Quick Tips
- Use high-quality, professional images
- Ensure images are bright and inviting
- Avoid cluttered or busy backgrounds
- Test on both light and dark overlays
- Consider the emotional impact - images should inspire confidence and motivation
